# Design: Exclude a heading from the TOC via the `no-toc` class ## Summary The change lives entirely in the `toc` extension (`TocTreeprocessor.run` in `markdown/extensions/toc.py`). `attr_list` is a treeprocessor that runs before `toc` and has already put `class="no-toc"` on the heading element, so `run` only needs to check the element's `class` attribute. A heading whose space-separated classes include `no-toc` still gets its id (generated through `unique`, so `contents`, `contents_1`, ...), anchors and permalinks, but is not appended to `toc_tokens`. Because the TOC markup and `md.toc_tokens` are both built from that list, one check satisfies FR-001 to FR-003. No option is added (FR-005 is BLOCKED) and no new import is needed, so core and extension boundaries are untouched. ## Changes | File | Symbol | Change | ACs | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---| | markdown/extensions/toc.py | TocTreeprocessor.run | modify | AC-FR-001-1, AC-FR-001-2, AC-FR-001-3, AC-FR-002-1, AC-FR-002-2, AC-FR-003-1, AC-FR-003-2 | Add `and 'no-toc' not in el.attrib.get('class', '').split()` to the condition that appends to `toc_tokens`. Id generation, anchors and permalinks stay unchanged for such headings. | | tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_toc.py | new TestTOCNoTocClass | add | AC-FR-001-1, AC-FR-001-2, AC-FR-001-3, AC-FR-002-1, AC-FR-002-2, AC-FR-003-1, AC-FR-003-2 | New test class using `Markdown(extensions=['toc','attr_list'])`. | | docs/changelog.md | - | modify | - | Entry under `## [Unreleased]` -> `### Added`: headings with the `no-toc` class (via `attr_list`) are excluded from the `toc` output and `md.toc_tokens`. | ## Interface No new options. Headings whose `class` attribute contains the token `no-toc` are excluded; the class stays in the output (`class="no-toc"`, id after it, as `attr_list` renders today). Text T = `# Guide\n\n## Contents {: .no-toc }\n\n[TOC]\n\n## Install\n\n## Usage`, extensions `['toc', 'attr_list']`. Expected output of `md.convert(T)`: ```
